questions.question: Whom does Ezekiel 34 condemn?
options: The false prophets who spoke aloud only their own foolish dreams
The corrupt priests who had defiled the holy temple of the LORD
The cruel foreign kings who oppressed and crushed the people
The shepherds of Israel who fed themselves and not the flock
questions.answer: The shepherds of Israel who fed themselves and not the flock

questions.question: Who promises to become the true shepherd of the flock?
options: The priests who would return to the temple
A foreign king raised up to deliver them
God himself, who will seek out his sheep
A council of elders chosen from the tribes
questions.answer: God himself, who will seek out his sheep

questions.question: Ezekiel 34 promises to set up one shepherd, my servant David, over them.
Woe to the shepherds of Israel who have been feeding _____!
I myself will tend My _____ and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
